column1: # Core 100 (fr): hand-curated starter set (frequent function words + frequent concrete
# vocabulary suited to children). Ranks are an approximate frequency order
# a published corpus list. Czech glosses need native-speaker review before wider use.
# Ranks 1-20 keep the IPA of the earlier sample; IPA left blank where unverified. Examples
# contain the lemma's citation form where natural
